settings.title: Dready × Reds
settings.text: Reds is an underground veteran of East Anglian sound-system culture — decades deep in the rave scene, and on the mic with members of Wu-Tang and Mobb Deep. On this joint he brings two rising stars from the East of England making their mark as ones to watch.

settings.title: Ash Walker — Dready Roots Mix
settings.text: An exclusive New Year roots mix from Ash Walker — the fiercely underground DJ known for deep selections of soul, jazz, reggae, Latin and roots & culture, and co-founder of the all-vinyl Shakedown sound system.

settings.title: Izachar — 'Dready' minimix
settings.text: Our first ever Dready Selecta mix goes to Izachar — producer, DJ and A&R on Congo Natty's label Rekovery Records, making jungle since 2020 with guidance from the legend himself.
